name: Agatsuma Taiga
source:
Entered the police force straight from high school by passing the police academy exam, joining the Public Security Bureau as a non-career-track officer.
After the incident, he is assigned to Sonogi’s security detail. Quiet and composed, but extraordinarily skilled.
Rather than stepping into the spotlight himself, he prefers to devote his loyalty to someone he deems worthy.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
